title: Layer vertex values match circuit evaluation
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations, and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each of its $n$ inputs. For every layer $m<\mathrm{depth}(F)+1$ and every node $u$ in that layer, the Boolean value produced by the gate list through layer $m$ at the index assigned to $u$ equals the value of $u$ when the layered circuit is evaluated on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
